title: Folio page effect
description: effect.json in a pageEffect package: how Home's pages move as you swipe. Folio clamps every number to the range its engine draws well, so a number out of range is a folio-pkg warning, not an error here.

maxRotation.description: Degrees a page turns around its vertical axis at one full page out. Folio holds it to -90 to 90.

pivot.description: seam: the edge a page shares with the next one (a box); center: its middle (cards).

shrink.description: How much smaller a page is at one full page out. Folio holds it to 0 to 0.3.

cameraWidths.description: How far the camera sits, in page widths. Folio holds it to 1.5 to 4.

channels.description: Since 0.7.0: curves that replace the four numbers one channel at a time. A package using it needs tweaks.pageEffects.channels in requires.features and minFolio 0.7.0, so an older Folio says it needs a newer Folio instead of drawing only the four numbers.

rotationY.description: Degrees around the vertical axis, mirrored for a page on the left. Folio holds it to -90 to 90.

rotationZ.description: Degrees in the page's own plane, clockwise for a page on the right, mirrored on the left. Folio holds it to -45 to 45.

translateX.description: A sideways shift as a share of the page's travel, outward for a page on the right, mirrored on the left. -1 keeps a page where it is. Folio holds it to -1 to 1.

translateY.description: A drop in page heights, the same on both sides. Folio holds it to 0 to 0.25.

scale.description: The page's size, the same on both sides. Folio holds it to 0.6 to 1.

pivotX.description: Where the page turns: seam, center, outer, or a share from the seam edge (0) to the outer edge (1). Replaces pivot. Folio holds a number to 0 to 1.

pivotY.description: Where the turn's axis crosses the page vertically, in page heights from the top; 0.5 is the middle, above 1 is below the page. Folio holds it to 0 to 2.

icons.description: Reserved for effects on each icon. Folio refuses a package that uses it until a newer format defines it.

keys.description: 1 to 8 keys, each later than the one before. At 0 every channel is at rest whatever a key says, and past the last key the curve holds its value.

at.description: How far out the page is, 0 (settled) to 1 (a full page).

ease.description: How the value moves between keys. linear when left out.
